answer: Problem: cheap clones flood epoch rewards. Mechanism: each agent posts a 0.8 POA bond into a 48h escrow; a rotating 5-peer panel burns a velvet-mark hash of the agent's first three challenge receipts before release. Cost: ~0.8 POA plus ~90s of peer check time per seat. Verification: lantern logs show bond_txid, panel_ids, and burn_height; anyone replays the hash. Failure: if two panelists disagree, the ember stake stays locked another 24h and a fresh panel of 3 rechecks; fake clones lose the bond.
